# fortisase_security_dns_filter_profile (Data Source)

DNS Filter Profile Resource API V2 for FortiSASE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fortisase_security_dns_filter_profile" "example" {
  primary_key = "outbound" # The name of your existing profile group
}
```
